name.description: Pool name; becomes part of the environment variable HEAVYQ_<NAME>.

values.description: A range "4100-4199", or a list of names or integers.

size.description: A capacity-only pool: the values are 1..size.

port.description: true: the values are TCP ports, probed before they are handed out. Absent: a pool called "port" or ending in "_port" is a port pool.

Pool.description: A named pool of values handed out with --needs: ports, database names, browser seats.

file.description: Checklist file, relative to the repository root (default .heavyq/anchor.md).

extra.description: Extra read-only sources, as globs relative to the repository root.

Anchor.description: The anchor checklist: the work items of `heavyq item`.

name.description: Gate name: lower case, used in lane names, file names and `heavyq gate run <name>`.

run.description: Shell commands, run in order with `sh -c`. Each must pass on this exact tree for the gate to be proven.

prio.description: Queue priority of the gate's commands; 1 runs first.

light.description: Light job: may use the light slots and jump ahead into them.

remote.description: Where to run: "local", "auto" (best machine) or the name of a [[remote]] of the user config.

needs.description: Pool values every command holds while it runs, for example ["pg", "port:2"]. A gate with needs runs on this machine.

with.description: Sibling repositories every command needs next to this one, "name@ref" (a directory next to the repository, or a path containing "/"; ref defaults to HEAD). Passed to the run as --with: pinned to a commit, shipped with it on remote runs, and part of the proof identity.

need_gh.description: The commands use the GitHub CLI with this machine's login, so the gate runs here only (--need-gh). Not combinable with a named remote.

Gate.description: A named list of shell commands that must all pass on the current code (heavyq gate status, heavyq gate run).

max_proof_share.description: Share of the 30 minute lease budget the expected proof time (p50 x iterations) may use.

iterations.description: Proof runs an item is expected to need before it passes; the expected proof time is the proof's p50 duration times this.

Items.description: Limits of the claim size gate: `heavyq item claim` refuses an item whose proof is expected to outlast the lease.

remote.description: "local" (the default), "auto" (the scheduler picks among local and the configured remotes, free slots first) or the name of a [[remote]]. A gate with its own remote key keeps it; --remote wins over both.

rawProof.description: Where `heavyq item done --run` and `heavyq gate run` run proofs for this repository; the user config has the same table.

title: heavyq.toml
description: heavyq.toml at the repository root: the gates that say what "proven" means, named pools and the anchor checklist.
